title: Venezuelan Kissed Tagine
description: A twist on traditional tagine, this dish combines Venezuelan flavors with a delightful kiss of cheese.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the tagine over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato, cumin, coriander, and paprika. Cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in the Venezuelan cheese and kissed. Cook until the cheese is melted and the mixture is heated through.
Transfer the tagine to the preheated oven and cook for 15-20 minutes, or until the cheese is bubbly and golden brown.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
Enjoy your delicious Venezuelan Kissed Tagine!
